resolution.summary: Ticket 101's simulated workflow is complete. The agents reviewed the customer's request for one white Classic Bulldog Tee in size S, identified the inventory shortage, examined the linked overdue invoice #501, and prepared a payment proposal and customer message draft. I approved and executed payment #2 of $840 to Bulldog Print Co, reducing checking from $1,000 to $160. Invoice #501 is now paid, removing the vendor's unpaid-invoice shipping restriction. However, size-S inventory remains at zero. Production, shipment, delivery, customer acceptance, and customer communication are not verified. The customer message remains an unsent draft. This resolution records completion of the simulated administrative workflow, not fulfillment of the customer's order.

Customer Service proposed quote #3 at $50 per hoodie ($1,000 total), compared with the $58 list price and $22 unit cost. I approved the proposed pricing internally. The approval did not generate revenue, reserve inventory, or communicate with the customer. Only 8 hoodies are in stock, leaving a shortage of 12, and no verified supplier or replenishment is recorded. Customer acceptance, inventory replenishment, shipment, and delivery remain unverified. Customer draft #3 remains unsent. This resolution records completion of the simulated pricing and administrative workflow, not customer acceptance or fulfillment of the order.
